$comment: Plugin hook registration. SELF-DISCOVERING bootstrapper. EMPIRICAL (datavidence investigations 2026-06-27 / 2026-06-28): plugin hooks DO fire in both terminal Claude Code and the desktop app, BUT (a) the desktop app does NOT set CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and (b) Cowork does not shell-expand ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}. The earlier bootstrapper (read CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, else exit 0) therefore fired-but-no-op'd in the desktop app, so the meta-learner did nothing there. Fix: each command first tries CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (set in terminal CLI, short-circuits the lookup with no regression), and if absent resolves the plugin install dir AT RUNTIME from ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json (installPath), with a glob of ~/.claude/plugins/cache/*/psotobverse-utils/* (newest) as fallback, then runpy's the real hook. If nothing resolves or the script is missing, exit 0 (FAIL-OPEN). Depends only on what every install creates (installed_plugins.json + the cache), never on a source checkout. No ${...} and no inner double quotes -> portable across bash/cmd/PowerShell. All hooks are Python-stdlib (no venv). NOTE: the desktop app runs hooks (side effects work: signal capture, handoff, dirty-bit) but does NOT inject SessionStart additionalContext into the model (Anthropic feature request #47993) — for auto-resume-by-injection use the terminal, or have CLAUDE.md tell the agent to self-read SESSION_STATE.md. The SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/SessionEnd hooks are the OPT-IN meta-learner: they fire in every session but no-op unless the project ships .claude/meta-learner.json.

hooks.command: python -c "import os,sys,json,glob,runpy; S='nothing_loose.py'; r=os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT'); j=os.path.expanduser('~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json'); d=(json.load(open(j)) if (not r and os.path.exists(j)) else {}); r=r or next((sorted(v,key=lambda e:e.get('version',''))[-1].get('installPath') for k,v in d.get('plugins',{}).items() if k.startswith('psotobverse-utils')), None); g=glob.glob(os.path.expanduser('~/.claude/plugins/cache/*/psotobverse-utils/*')); r=r or (sorted(g)[-1] if g else None); p=(os.path.join(r,'hooks',S) if r else None); (runpy.run_path(p, run_name='__main__') if (p and os.path.exists(p)) else sys.exit(0))"
